lines.1: All right, I'll head out early today.
lines.3: I'm glad we got so many sunny days this summer.
lines.4: It let me have a great time with the Princess.
lines.5: Best summer vacation of my life.
lines.6: Summer vacation was almost over, though.
lines.7: From here on, I'd spend autumn and winter with the Princess.
lines.10: 「Well, for the last one, at least.」
lines.12: 「Why don't we take a little walk?」
lines.13: Something about the Princess wasn't right.
lines.14: 「It started in this park, so I thought it should end here too.」
lines.21: 「As of 5:48 p.m. today, August 29, the Kiriya x Tsushima pairing is hereby terminated.」
lines.22: She said it as calmly as could be.
lines.23: 「Understand? As of today, you and I are no longer dating.」
lines.24: 「You're joking. You're making it sound like you're canceling a contract again... This is way too sudden.」
lines.26: 「The contract that says I'm dating you.」
lines.27: 「Did I do something to make you mad, Princess?」
lines.33: 「I'm not angry with you at all.」
lines.34: 「If anything, I had fun. So I owe you my thanks. Thank you, Tsushima.」
lines.36: The Princess looked into the sunset.
lines.37: 「Summer's almost over. And that means a princess's summer adventure is over too.」
lines.38: 「So... it really was just a summer fling to you?」
lines.39: 「I never thought it would go this far when we started.」
lines.40: 「But you proved much better than I expected, and we wound up becoming quite intimate.」
lines.41: 「I'll use this experience to help me climb even higher.」
lines.42: 「Next time, you should date a more ordinary girl.」
lines.43: 「But I... I still want you, Princess...」
lines.44: 「To put it bluntly, you've become an obstacle on my road to greatness.」
lines.45: 「It would be different if I were the sort of woman who chose a man over ambition. But I'm the sort who chooses ambition.」
lines.46: 「And Tsushima, you may be a decent catch by Ryuumeikan standards, but...」
lines.47: 「Suppose I go to university--Too University caliber, naturally.」
lines.48: 「It will be full of handsome young men from fine families, with brilliant grades and even brighter futures.」
lines.49: 「Are you confident you're more attractive than all of them?」
lines.51: 「See? Our stations in life were far too different from the start.」
lines.52: 「But by ordinary standards, I think you're quite a catch. Hold your head high and find yourself a nice girl.」
lines.53: She gave my shoulder a couple of pats.
lines.54: 「And that's that. Don't call my cell anymore, all right?」
lines.56: Without thinking, I reached out and grabbed her arm.
lines.57: It held the warmth I had embraced so many times.
lines.59: 「Goodbye, Tsushima. At school, we can go back to talking like ordinary classmates.」
lines.60: She left me with those outrageously self-serving words.
lines.61: Before I knew it, tears were streaming down my face.
lines.65: I curled up on my bed.
lines.66: 「I got swept up in the moment... and let this happen again...」
lines.67: I'd known all along that the Princess was in a different league.
lines.68: But I went and took it seriously...!
lines.71: I tore out of the house--
lines.72: and ran until I lost all sense of myself.
lines.73: But it didn't change how I felt about the Princess at all.
lines.74: Otome came home for the start of the second term.
lines.78: All the work I'd done for the Princess hadn't gone to waste.
lines.79: 「You... Has your face grown a little more mature? You seem more polished somehow.」
lines.80: Even Otome was saying things like that.
lines.81: That summer with the Princess had been deeply worthwhile.
lines.83: I'd give the second term my best.
lines.84: I'd give up on the Princess.
lines.85: I woke up the next morning.
lines.88: Not long ago, we'd been sleeping together in this bed.
lines.93: Was there really nothing I could do?
